releaseNotes: My Diary 1.0.214: App Share now attaches the original My Diary logo image with the formatted invitation and existing direct APK download link. Existing share chooser, app identity, notes, photos, PINs, locks, widgets, and saved data are preserved.
webReleaseNotes: Web Update 405: On an expanded, unlocked saved Note, the displayed name/title now has a purple raised 3D border on all four sides, and the displayed writing/body has a gold raised 3D border on all four sides. The note editor fields remain unchanged. Existing notes, photos, PINs, locks, and saved data are preserved.
